judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The last bark ('a filthy and greedy pack of brutes! The worst was their lord') has Nox's blunt exclamatory guard voice, but the soup-pot-and-crows gag is overbuilt whimsy and 'Come by the gate for a mug of cider' reads like a modern writer padding a bark; the three lines also don't hang together as one guard.
